notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Final Demo: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hello! The second patch for ‘Oops! You’re the Hero!’s final demo is out! This update includes: 




✨VISUALS:

Adjustment of VFX indicator Tut’s beginning dialogue in the temple area

VFX indicator of the Wizard spilling liquid on the Thief

Volume Control Slider added 

Pause Menu UI updated 





🛠️MECHANICS:

Master Volume Controller added





🎶SOUNDS: 

Rope swing whoosh

Sound indicator of dialogue/text box switch 





🐞BUGS: 

Rope swing adjustment 

Player movement stopped during cutscenes

Explosion damage added to all Gob Boss minions (was only to Gob Min and Gob Moot, now includes Gob Max and Gob Mud)





The next patch to come out will include:

Continued Bug Fixes 

Continued UI/Menu updates 

Continued polish

 

Thank you for your patience, and for playing!

Thank you for your patience, and for playing!

notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Demo Update
notes.notes:
Announcement!

The newest demo for 'Oops! You're the Hero!' has been released! There have been quite a few changes: 

All music has been redone and added 
  Explosive Barrels are now present and effect enemies 
 Multiple pathways to get through the levels, both violent and passive 
  Rope mechanic has been added to swing across platforms


Next Steps Will Include

 Continued Bug Fixes 
 Creating a Mac build
 Polishing Rope mechanic
 Visual updates


Thank you for being patient, and for playing!

notes.title: Oops! You're the Hero! Demo - Patch 1
notes.notes:
Announcement!

A week has passed since the release of the game's demo! There have been a few issues found, so this past week has been tackling bugs and some polish. The first patch for 'Oops! You're the Hero!' is live! This includes: 

Updated lighting settings
 Fixed bug in the Main Menu concerning the mouse and button selection 
 Fixed bug concerning the Pause Menu and restarting the game
 Added a Loading Screen for easier transition between Menus and Demo Level


Next Steps Will Include

 Continued Bug Fixes 
 Creating a Mac build
 Roadmap Creation for Upcoming Demo Updates, including final Demo Build 


Thank you for being patient, and for playing!
